subject.title: [Bug] Race condition in approval-classifier.ts when tokenization exceeds max tokens

question: Can the current ACP client forward or execute any command payload while its corresponding permission classification is unresolved, and does the ACP SDK contract permit overlapping stream events during that wait?
rationale: The issue alleges an authorization bypass but supplies no protocol trace, while changing synchronization at this boundary could alter execution ordering or availability; an owner must establish the actual security contract first.

options.title: Validate protocol ordering
options.body: Instrument or test the current permission-request path and keep the issue only if a payload can cross the boundary before classification resolves.

options.title: Reject the reported model
options.body: Close after documenting that classification is synchronous or awaited and that no tokenized stream-chunk path exists in the affected surface.

recommendation.title: Validate protocol ordering
recommendation.body: Instrument or test the current permission-request path and keep the issue only if a payload can cross the boundary before classification resolves.
